messages.subject: adding id/class attributes to plot elements.
messages.subject_clean: adding id/class attributes to plot elements.
messages.body_plain:
After several talks about Web Development with R, a returning question
seems to be how to embed interactive graphics, i.e. graphics that can
be manipulated from the browser. For example, when the user clicks the
xlab or ylab in the plot it should be able to rename it, or in a
ggplot2 the user should be able to hide and show layers without
replotting.

Minimally required for this would be 2 things: a vector based graphics
format supported by the browser, and a way to add id/class attributes
to elements of the image. The format could be for example SVG, or
CANVAS, or at some point maybe even postscript with client side
postscript-to-html5 javascript libraries like http://logand.com/sw/wps/index.html.
For now, SVG seems to be best implemented.

My questions is, is there a way to add id/class attributes to elements
of a plot. For example, of axis labels had a static ID in the SVG XML,
it is easy to add onClick events in Javascript. Similarly, if all
elements of a layer belonged to a certain class, they can be hidden
and shown from Javascript.

I have tried the SVG devices from CRAN packages Cairo and RSvgDevice,
of which only the former seems to add some, not very useful, id tags
to the xml. A way to customize this would greatly improve
accessability.

Jeroen Ooms
www.jeroenooms.com <http://www.jeroenooms.com>

Do I need to specify it in the form of a > handler, or can I just prefix my existing Rscripts with a command > like mem.limits(vsize=50*1024*1024), in the same way i set time limits? A conservative strategy would be set mem.limits() using REvalOnStartup . That way it gets set before any request is served. But you can call that any time.
